Hero.subtitle: Living Spaces In Harmony with Nature

Services.subtitle: From design to execution, from care to detail — we create lasting, nature-aligned spaces in every project.

About.p1: We bring together the nature of people, the spirit of nature, and the character of space on a single line.
About.p2: We closely follow landscape practices, gardens, and design approaches from different geographies around the world — interpreting the knowledge we gather from various regions through our own design language.
About.p3: We add value to nature and quality to living spaces.
About.quote: A good life begins with good design. Every detail, with care.
About.imageAlt: Bay Peyzaj — Design in Harmony with Nature

Process.subtitle: A transparent and predictable process from the first meeting to the final handover.
Process.step1Desc: We visit your site, analyse climatic conditions and soil characteristics. We listen to your needs and aspirations.
Process.step2Desc: With original concepts and 3D visualisations, we show you exactly what your project will look like before breaking ground. Every detail is decided together.
Process.step3Desc: We bring the approved project to life with our expert team and selected materials, within the agreed timeline and budget. Every phase is closely monitored.
Process.step4Desc: A detailed care guide is provided at handover. Optional periodic maintenance contracts keep your garden vibrant throughout all four seasons.

LegalKvkk.title: Privacy Notice
LegalKvkk.subtitle: Prepared under Article 10 of Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK).
LegalKvkk.s1Text: {name} ("Business"), a sole proprietorship operating as {brand} at {address}, is the data controller.
LegalKvkk.s1VerbisYes: The Company is registered in the Data Controllers’ Registry (VERBIS).
LegalKvkk.s1VerbisExempt: The Business considers that it is not subject to VERBIS registration under the applicable exemption criteria.
LegalKvkk.s2Intro: If you fill in a form, and when you visit the site, the following data may be processed:
LegalKvkk.s2i3: Request content: service of interest and free-text message
LegalKvkk.s2i4: Security and usage: IP address, browser type, page-view and performance data (server logs and cookieless analytics)
LegalKvkk.s3Method: Data are collected electronically via the quote and contact forms and automatically (server logs, Vercel Analytics and Speed Insights). Completing a form is optional; without it we cannot reply via WhatsApp.
LegalKvkk.s3i1: Art. 5/2-c — Necessary for concluding or performing a contract (handling your quote, site-visit and contact request)
LegalKvkk.s3i2: Art. 5/2-ç — Compliance with a legal obligation
LegalKvkk.s3i3: Art. 5/2-f — Legitimate interest (site security and performance measurement, without harming your fundamental rights)
LegalKvkk.s3i4: Art. 5/1 — Your explicit consent when you submit the form: sending the request via WhatsApp and the related international transfer
LegalKvkk.s4i1: Handling quote, site-visit and service requests
LegalKvkk.s4i2: Contacting you by phone or WhatsApp
LegalKvkk.s4i4: Measuring site security, performance and visitor statistics
LegalKvkk.s5Intro: Your personal data may be transferred to the following recipients for the stated purposes:
LegalKvkk.s5i1: WhatsApp / Meta Platforms: when you submit a form, your name, phone, service choice and message are sent to the Business WhatsApp number. WhatsApp’s infrastructure may be located outside Türkiye.
LegalKvkk.s5i2: Vercel Inc.: technical data may be processed on US-based infrastructure for hosting, Vercel Analytics and Speed Insights.
LegalKvkk.s5i3: Competent public authorities: where required by law.
LegalKvkk.s5Abroad: Transfers to WhatsApp and Vercel constitute international transfers (KVKK Art. 9). By submitting the form you give explicit consent to this transfer.
LegalKvkk.s6Text: Quote and contact data are kept for as long as needed to handle the request and resolve possible disputes, and for any longer period required by law. They are then deleted or anonymised.
LegalKvkk.s6TextCustom: Quote and contact data are kept for {period}, and for any longer period required by law. They are then deleted or anonymised.
LegalKvkk.s7Intro: Under KVKK Article 11 you have the right:
LegalKvkk.s7i1: To learn whether your personal data are being processed
LegalKvkk.s7i2: To request information if they are processed
LegalKvkk.s7i3: To learn the purpose of processing and whether they are used in line with that purpose
LegalKvkk.s7i4: To know the third parties to whom data are transferred, in Türkiye or abroad
LegalKvkk.s7i5: To request correction of incomplete or inaccurate data
LegalKvkk.s7i6: To request deletion or destruction under KVKK Article 7
LegalKvkk.s7i7: To request that correction or deletion be notified to third parties to whom the data were transferred
LegalKvkk.s7i8: To object to a result against you arising solely from automated analysis of the data
LegalKvkk.s7i9: To claim compensation for damage caused by unlawful processing
LegalKvkk.s8Before: You may submit requests in writing to
LegalKvkk.s8After: . Applications are concluded within thirty days under the Communiqué on the Procedures and Principles of Application to the Data Controller. If your request is refused, found insufficient or not answered in time, you may lodge a complaint with the Personal Data Protection Board.
LegalKvkk.s9Text: Appropriate technical and organisational measures are taken. Data are transmitted over encrypted connections (SSL/TLS); access is limited to authorised persons. WhatsApp transmission happens when WhatsApp opens on your device; form data are not stored on the Business server.

LegalCookies.title: Cookie Policy
LegalCookies.s1Text: Cookies are small text files a site writes to your browser. They can remember a visit or collect statistics. This site does not use non-essential cookies; language is chosen via the URL.
LegalCookies.tableRow1Col3: Visit statistics; does not write a cookie.
LegalCookies.tableRow2Col3: Page-speed measurement; does not write a cookie.
LegalCookies.tableNote: Because there are no non-essential cookies, no consent banner is shown. If Google Analytics, Meta Pixel or a similar tool is added, this table and the consent flow will be updated.
LegalCookies.s3Text: Your browser may still hold cookies from other sites. You can delete or block them in your browser settings:
LegalCookies.s3i1: Chrome: Settings → Privacy and security → Third-party cookies
LegalCookies.s3i3: Safari: Settings → Advanced → Block All Cookies
